newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germans seek free mkt wheat, barley exports. [CORRECTED 11:03 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Germans seek free mkt wheat, barley exports. [CORRECTED 11:03 GMT]

text.p: German grain traders placed bids for the export of 14,500 tonnes (corrects) of free market soft wheat, with the range of the restitution sought put between 5.50 and 6.48 Ecus per tonne, intervention board BLE said.
In free market barley, bids were received for 6,000 tonnes with a 32.50 Ecus/tonne rebate.
Traders also sought to export 100 tonnes of rice with a 2.79 Ecus/t rebate.
BLE said the preparation of intervention grain bids this morning would be delayed by computer problems.
